'''Newflamander''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Azurion]] at 6 iridescent moons after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Clad in scales as radiant as a blazing sun, Newflamander's every step is a fiery imprint upon the world."

Newflamander is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat. 

==Appearance==
A chubby, bipedal, red lizard with frilly accents. Newflamander sports a large magma tail, blue tongue, and a cheery expression. It has a white underbelly, and each of the frilly accents have a gradient of orange to white. It also has yellow horns, and blue horns on the side of its face. 

Newflamander's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with pink.

==Strategy==
[[File:Newflamander Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Newflamander's attack range]]
Newflamander is a strong, basic Fire DPS. While it may not have any super unique skills, it is always reliable damage in its lane. 
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Finally evolved into a Newflamander, but still not a dragon and still can't fly. Maybe it's fireballs will be bigger?"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "A golden flame marks Newflamander's tracks and can melt rocks into lava. Newflamander is the strongest fighter that evolved from the Blueflicks."
